method: New local Capstone 5.0.6 disassembly and LC_FUNCTION_STARTS; prior REA evidence reuse, no new REA invocation

findings.name: target-setup-fields
findings.observation: Model selector and target effect/PID stored; current modifier ID and pending request reset.

findings.name: source-pid-zero-special-case
findings.observation: PID0 special case; nonzero modifier PID uses the ordinary forwarder.

findings.name: create-serializer-argument
findings.observation: Loads target fields +0x4f4/+0x4f6 and supplies internal request code 0x3a to serializer.

findings.name: remove-serializer-argument
findings.observation: Loads existing modifier ID and supplies internal request code 0x3b to serializer.

findings.name: retain-pending-source
findings.observation: Copies the original source-change packet to +0x4e8/+0x4f0.

findings.name: assigned-modifier-id
findings.observation: Compares and stores incoming W3 as current modifier ID at +0x4f8.

findings.name: send-pending-after-id
findings.observation: Nonzero ID and pending PID allow forwarding the saved request; pending PID is cleared to 0xffff.

findings.name: channel-definition-context
findings.observation: Obtains target block information and sets MOD definition PID17 upper bound from the returned metadata.

limits: Internal serializer operation identifiers are not newly hardware-verified wire commands.
Allocation/default initialization in SHARC firmware is not analyzed here.
The caller supplying effect102/PID0 and full FW13 serialized defaults remain to be resolved.
